note: Forbidden: an IPFIX UDP datagram sent without a valid UDP checksum. TestRFC7011UDPChecksumEnabledOnSenderSocket (Linux) reads the socket NewSender dials and asserts SO_NO_CHECK clear for IPv4 and UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX clear for IPv6, red if either is set, so the kernel writes the checksum. Single-polarity marker: NewSender never sets either option.
